summary: HSPnetGridView is a custom GridView extension for ASP.NET WebForms, providing advanced numeric paging with support for toggling between paged and 'Show All' views, dynamic pager links, and enhanced UI elements for navigation.
purpose: To give users a flexible and accessible way to navigate large datasets in a tabular UI by implementing custom numeric paging logic, allowing toggling between page-based navigation and 'Show All', and offering UI controls such as ellipsis and next/previous buttons.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.description: Calculated as PageIndex * PageSize. Controls the starting row of displayed data.

fields.name: PageSize
fields.description: Number of records displayed per page.

actors.name: Developer
actors.role: Configures GridView paging options and UI.

workflows.name: Custom Numeric Pager Creation
steps: Instantiate NextPrevNumericPagerTemplate with current page index and page count.
Determine pager start and end indices based on current page.
Add previous button, next button, ellipsis if needed, and numeric page buttons.
Render selected page as label, others as clickable LinkButton.
Toggle paging mode and update button captions appropriately.

workflows.name: Paging Toggle Workflow
steps: If PageSize < maxPageSize, set PageSize = maxPageSize (Show All mode).
If PageSize >= maxPageSize, set PageSize = defaultPageSize (Paged mode).
Update Toggle Paging button caption accordingly.

business_rules: Show All is activated by setting PageSize to a very large value (maxPageSize).
When PageCount == 1 and PageSize == defaultPageSize, paging controls and toggle are hidden.
validations: Hide TogglePaging button if pager is not necessary (PageCount == 1 and PageSize == defaultPageSize).
conditions: If PageSize < maxPageSize, Show All mode is available.
If PageSize >= maxPageSize, revert to default paging.
system_behavior: GridView dynamically switches between Show All and paged view.
Pager UI adapts button labels and visibility based on current paging mode.
Numeric pager shows correct range of pages, with ellipsis controls as needed.
Selected page button is rendered as label, other pages as LinkButton.
dependencies: Depends on ASP.NET WebForms server-side control context.
exceptions: If the page index or count are invalid, UI may display fewer/more buttons than expected.
TogglePaging button is hidden when only one page is present.
content_gaps: No explicit error handling for invalid PageSize or PageIndex values.
No information about underlying data binding or sorting behaviors.
